raw_complete_case.estimand: KZ minus PL full-confirmation share among assessable retained commitments

finite_worklist_extreme_bounds.assumption: All original 27 KZ and 29 PL retained keys are eligible; all non-assessable legacy-worklist keys (including new ineligibility judgements) receive hypothetical full outcomes 0 or 1. This is solely a sensitivity retaining legacy eligibility, not a corrected-eligibility estimate. Not a confidence interval or national-population bound.

fixed_confirmed_eligibility_bounds.assumption: Eligibility fixed to cases adjudicated commitment; unresolved eligibility and newly ineligible keys excluded. Only missing binary outcomes vary. Not confidence intervals or national bounds.
